# Altitude Sports

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Canadian online retailer of outdoor, ski, camping, running and lifestyle apparel, footwear and gear from outdoor and fashion brands. Its help center states free standard shipping within Canada over 74 dollars and that it does not ship outside Canada; the site also carries a separate Marketplace section.

## Shopping notes

Same-day delivery in Greater Montreal and next-day in the GTA, Ottawa and Quebec City are described in its help center; confirm at checkout. Marketplace items are sold by third parties and have separate shipping terms.
